systems.system: Computer equipment supplied by UNHCR to civil-status services
systems.owner: UNHCR, as donor, to the civil-status services
systems.tiers: the civil-status centre of Pointe-Noire, the civil-status service of the town hall of Mvoumvou (an arrondissement of Pointe-Noire) and the Loandjili court; no connection stated; undated in the text, beside figures for 2022

note: The UN country team's review submission states that UNHCR equipped the civil-status service of the Mvoumvou town hall with computer tools, which is equipment with no connection stated; it also records local development plans given to local authorities, which are not ICT.
